title: condition-github-actions plugin configuration
description: Schema v1 for the condition-github-actions semrel plugin (supports github.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency). Configure via SEMREL_* environment variables.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_BRANCH.description: Optional branch name override. When set, require the GitHub Actions ref branch (GITHUB_REF_NAME or GITHUB_REF fallback) to match this value.
